title: The Gran Sasso laboratory and the Gerda experiment

tellings.quote: It is called the Gerda experiment because they are they didn't find it still find it. The so-called Majorana particle.

plain: Deep under the Gran Sasso mountain in Italy there is a physics laboratory that runs the Gerda experiment, a hunt for the Majorana particle, a particle physicists have predicted but never found, according to the Italian radar researcher Filippo Biondi. Biondi tells Michels about it in passing, saying of the particle that "they didn't find it, still find it. The so-called Majorana particle."
